fullPassage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. This reminded me of when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry. ❌ ③ mystery(미스터리)는 mining industry(광업)와 어울리지 않음
❌ ④ doubtful(의심스러운)은 감사의 맥락과 반대
